Content Budget Lab

Six weeks to build the harbour's 40 art assets and a weather system, inside a 2.0 ms art budget on the handheld. Choose how the budget is told to artists, when they find out an asset is too expensive, and when a technical artist joins the design, then see what gets reworked and what gets cut.

40 assets, one weather system, six weeks. Goal: harbour art within 2.0 ms, at most 2 artist-days of rework, and the weather ships.

Lesson 071: working with designers and artists

    What this shows

    Budgets in their own units

    "2.0 ms" means nothing in a modelling tool. "15,000 triangles and two 2K textures per boat" is something an artist can aim at.

    Feedback while creating

    An asset found too expensive weeks later has already been rigged, lit and placed. A meter in the editor catches it in minutes, when fixing is cheap.

    Tech in the first meeting

    A weather system designed without a frame budget gets cut. The same idea, shaped at kickoff by someone who knows the costs, ships.

    This lab is a model, not a measurement. It uses Lesson 071's numbers: 40 assets, harbour art at 1.8 ms when every asset is in budget, each over-budget asset +0.05 ms. Budgets in engineering terms leave 18 assets over; in creator terms, 8. Found at the weekly profile, a fix costs 1.5 artist-days and half are still unfixed at week 6; found live in the editor, a fix costs 0.5 days with a meter in ms only and 0.1 days with creator terms. The designers' weather costs 1.8 ms and is cut when found at the weekly profile (10 designer-days lost) or in the editor (4 days lost); designed at kickoff with a technical artist, it ships at 0.5 ms in its own budget line.
